messages:
Jamie Chen: Hey team — PR #20415 is blocked on CI. gateway-integ keeps failing on shard 3 with a timeout in TestGatewayConnection. tagging @Katie and @Owen for review/infra eyes. logs below:

Jamie Chen: ```
FAIL: TestGatewayConnection (timeout 2m)
--- FAIL: TestGatewayConnection (120.00s)
stack: net.DialTimeout -> context.DeadlineExceeded
last logs: GET /health -> 504 Gateway Timeout
CI shard: shard-3-gpu
```

Katie Liao: @Jamie can you paste the commit hash and whether this repros locally for you? Also any recent changes to connection pooling in the PR?

Jamie Chen: commit c3f9b2a, I ran the unit tests locally (short) and didn't hit this, integration is flaky locally too. PR touches gateway dial logic but only adds a small backoff tweak.

Owen Patel: leaning infra side — could be noisy network on that runner pool. Can you try a targeted rerun of shard-3? I can queue one but prefer you trigger so buildkite attribution stays on the PR.

Jamie Chen: queued a targeted rerun: https://buildkite.company.com/builds/98321?retry=shard-3 (queued)

ci-bot: Rerun started for PR #20415 (shard-3). Triggered by Jamie Chen.

Ben Ortiz: quick theory: last week we had an intermittent NAT table exhaustion on the gpu-runner autoscaling group — if shard-3 maps to that pool it's consistent with a bunch of 504s. Owen, do we still have the NAT scaling patch deployed?

Owen Patel: NAT fix rolled to prod yesterday but only for the autoscale group used by shard-1/2. shard-3 is on an older instance group that didn't pick up the change. I'm rolling a patch to shard-3's pool now. Should be deployed in ~8min.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard-3 -> FAILED (TestGatewayConnection timeout)

Jamie Chen: hmm still failing post-rerun even with patch in flight. logs look same. Maybe the test has a timing assumption that breaks under slightly slower runners. If so snapshot update might be required if behavior changed intentionally. @Katie does the change warrant a snapshot update?

Katie Liao: I don't think we should update snapshots for timeouts. Let's not mask a nondet. Two asks: 1) can you add a small repro harness in the PR so we can run the test in a tight loop locally (maybe `go test -run TestGatewayConnection -count=50`) and 2) try increasing the test timeout to 3m temporarily to see if it reduces flakes.

Jamie Chen: OK will push a quick test patch with both. Ping once done.

(20 minutes later)

Jamie Chen: pushed c3f9b2a+test-loop tweak (branch: pr/20415-integ-repro). Triggering another targeted rerun: https://buildkite.company.com/builds/98340?retry=shard-3

ci-bot: Rerun started for PR #20415 (shard-3). Triggered by Jamie Chen.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard-3 -> SUCCESS 

Ben Ortiz: nice — that matches NAT patch timing + the timeout tweak. Looks transient.

Katie Liao: I reviewed the change quickly — small backoff tweak is fine. Left one comment about log clarity but not blocking. 

Owen Patel: infra patch landed on shard-3 pool. No further action from infra.

Jamie Chen: thanks all. request: can someone give an LGTM so I can merge during the current merge window? 

Katie Liao: LGTM :thumbsup:

Ben Ortiz: +1

Jamie Chen: merging now. cc @oncall for post-merge watch. :rocket:
